player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Negotiation Game.
You have some resources, and your task is to trade such that the total value of your resources increases.
The resources and associated values you currently have are:
	+ {resource_value_list}
At each turn, you can talk to your opponent and make a trade offer.
Use the following special tokens for actions:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': To accept an incoming offer.
  - '[Deny]': To deny an incoming offer (default).
The game lasts for {max_turns} turns in total.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Mutlangi u ringete ku amukela ntirho handle ko va ni mali leyi lavekaka.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Nguvo leri ringanisiwa. Koloni {col} i ngana nikati.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Nguvo leri ringanisiwa. Koloni {col} i manene.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Mutlangi {player_id} u ringete ku endla xiringanyeto xa bindzu handle ko va ni switirhisiwa leswi lavekaka.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Mutlangi {player_id} u endle xiringanyeto xo cinca hi ndlela leyi hoxeke.
invalid_move.no_new_offer: Mutlangi {player_id} a nga endlanga xiringanyeto xin'wana xa ku cincana.

offers.accept: Mutlangi {acceptor_id} u amukele nyiko ya mutlangi wa le handle {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Player {player_id} made the following offer to Player {opponent_id}: Offered items: {offered} -> Requested items: {requested}

outcome.win: Mutlangi {winner_id} u hlurile hi ku va na mbuyelo lowukulu eka nxavo wa nhundzu.
outcome.draw: Ku cinca loku fanaka eka nkoka wa nhundzu ya vatlangi hinkwavo.
